tagline: Elbow & Knee Brightening Cream – Even Tone for Dark Patches
intro: Reveal smoother, brighter, and more even-toned skin with KB Elbow & Knee Brightening Cream, specially formulated to target dark, rough areas on elbows, knees, and neck. This advanced brightening formula helps reduce pigmentation, dryness, and uneven tone while deeply nourishing the skin.

Enriched with powerful actives like Glutathione, Niacinamide, and Vitamin C, the cream works to lighten dark patches and restore natural radiance. Turmeric provides soothing and antioxidant benefits, while Glycerin locks in moisture to keep skin soft and healthy.

li: Helps reduce pigmentation and uneven skin tone
Deeply moisturizes and softens rough skin

p: Apply a small amount to clean, dry elbows, knees, or neck. Massage gently until fully absorbed. Use twice daily for best results.
Perfect for daily care to achieve visibly brighter, smoother, and healthier-looking skin

full: Elbow & Knee Brightening Cream – Even Tone for Dark Patches
